continuity_scope: Catalyst Game Labs' Shadowrun: Sixth World Core Rulebook, City Edition: Hong Kong, limited to the current official Catalyst product page and the official Shadowrun Sixth World resources/errata archive. The product page states that City Edition: Hong Kong contains the full updated rules content of Shadowrun, Sixth World, with extra Hong Kong art, fiction, contacts, and plot hooks. This is a specific Sixth World rules-product pass, not a general Shadowrun continuity pass; it excludes earlier editions, Earthdawn links, novels, videogames, supplements, missions, and home campaigns.

work_or_witnesses.work: Shadowrun: Sixth World Core Rulebook, City Edition: Hong Kong
work_or_witnesses.edition: Catalyst's current City Edition: Hong Kong product; public product page describes full updated Sixth World rules content plus location material but does not state a publication date.
Official resources page listing SR6 Core Rulebook errata from August 2019 and February 2020, plus a comprehensive FAQ.
Official February 2020 errata document for the original Sixth World core-rulebook printings; used only as a version/errata boundary.

coverage_rule: Terms-only rules/setting audit. The accessible official City Edition page supplies a product-level rules frame but does not expose a bounded, claim-level set of named dramatic character profiles. No character or relationship records are made. Metatypes, archetypal runner roles, corporations/factions, magic traditions, the Matrix, cyberware, items, places, and game rules remain terms/dimensions. The City Edition's additional fiction, contacts, and plot hooks are not ingested from product description; a separate exact accessible product witness is required for any named-character claim.
omissions: All named Sixth World characters, including City Edition contacts and fiction figures, because the selected public product description does not provide their claim-level profiles.
All metatypes, archetypes, corporations, factions, magic traditions, Matrix entities, cyberware, equipment, locations, and rules as character nodes.
All prior Shadowrun editions, Earthdawn links, novels, videogames, adventures/missions, Sixth World Companion and other supplements, external adaptations, fan material, and home-campaign outcomes.
content_cautions: The official product framing depicts a dystopian world of corporate domination, social marginalization, crime, surveillance, technology, magic, and potentially lethal risk. Material involving weapons, injury, coercion, exploitation, and inequality should be handled with table-appropriate boundaries.

Metatype, cultural, corporate, and spiritual imagery are fictional game constructs; they must not be mapped onto real peoples, disability, ethnicity, religion, or social class without qualified, source-specific evidence.
uncertainties: The official City Edition page says it contains full updated rules content, while the resource archive separately lists 2019 and 2020 original-core errata. This pass records both as version evidence but does not assume or reconstruct which individual errata entries are incorporated in City Edition without a page-level City Edition witness.
The accessible official product page does not give a City Edition publication date; the review date is recorded instead of inventing one.

No Earthdawn connection, retcon, or shared-timeline claim is established by this restricted official witness set. Such claims remain outside this source pass even where other franchise materials discuss them.
evidence_basis: Catalyst Game Labs' official store and the official Shadowrun Sixth World resource site only. The City Edition page establishes the exact selected product, 2080 setting frame, megacorporate technology-and-magic premise, runner roles, and updated-rules claim; resources establish the published errata archive. No fan wiki, community resource, or adaptation is used.
